concept: Before and after organising a weekly money plan; illustrated, not a testimonial or financial guarantee

copy.headline: Get your finances in order.
copy.support: Simple steps. A clearer money plan.

prompt: Edit this Weekly Finances advertising creative. Preserve the square format, the same man in both panels, left worried with scattered receipts versus right calm with an organized weekly money picture, dark charcoal/olive and orange palette, polished realistic editorial 3D style and quality. Change the marketing message to the actual financial benefit, not taking a quiz. Replace the big top headline with exactly 'Get your finances in order.' Add a short supporting line below it exactly 'Simple steps. A clearer money plan.' Replace the orange bottom CTA with exactly 'Get your free money plan'. Remove EVERY occurrence of 'quiz', including the current 'Take the free quiz'. No domain, URL, website address, QR code, currency amount, percentage, or earning/savings guarantee anywhere. Keep the brand name 'Weekly Finances' as a small top brand line, but remove the generic calendar icon beside that brand line; a clean typographic brand line is enough. Keep the two panel labels 'WITHOUT A PLAN' and 'WITH WEEKLY FINANCES'. Keep the captions 'Guessing what’s left' and 'Knowing what’s next'. All key text must fit well within the central 86% of the square with generous safe margins and crisp mobile-readable sans serif typography. Emphasize simplicity, a helpful free starting plan and a more organized weekly routine, not sudden wealth. Do not add app-store ratings or testimonials. Return a finished ad, not a device mockup. Preserve everything else.
